questions.question: When must you stop at a zebra crossing?
options: Once someone steps onto the crossing
Only if a traffic warden is there
questions.explanation: You must give way once someone steps onto a zebra crossing.

questions.question: What is banned inside the white zig-zag zone at a crossing?
options: Overtaking the leading vehicle or parking
questions.explanation: You must not overtake or park on crossing zig-zag lines.
